div.p:
This diagram shows the major boards and hardware components inside a typical server. Power enters through the PSU and is distributed by the power distribution board (PDB). The motherboard contains the CPU, memory (DIMM slots), voltage regulators (VRMs), firmware storage, and platform sensors. The management board hosts the BMC and control logic for system monitoring and remote management.
Additional functionality is provided through PCIe cards, storage backplanes, networking interfaces, and front-panel devices.
These components will appear throughout later chapters when discussing individual subsystems such as power management, storage, networking, and platform management.
